groups.transcript: June 1, 1972, Iraq nationalized its oil. The wealth extracted for 50 years by British petroleum came home. Per capita income tripled. Every child received free education through university. Every citizen received free health care. UNESCO awarded Iraq its literacy prize.
groups.phonemes: dʒˈuːn fˈɜːst, nˈaɪntiːn sˈɛvənti tˈuː. ɪɹˈæk nˈæʃənəlˌaɪzd ɪts ˈɔɪl. ðə wˈɛlθ ɛkstɹˈæktᵻd fɔːɹ fˈɪfti jˈɪɹz baɪ bɹˈɪɾɪʃ pətɹˈoʊliːəm — kˈeɪm hˈoʊm. pɜː kˈæpɪɾə ˈɪŋkʌm tɹˈɪpəld. ˈɛvɹi tʃˈaɪld ɹᵻsˈiːvd fɹˈiː ˌɛdʒuːkˈeɪʃən θɹuː jˌuːnɪvˈɜːsᵻɾi. ˈɛvɹi sˈɪɾɪzən ɹᵻsˈiːvd fɹˈiː hˈɛlθkɛɹ. ʌnˈɛskoʊ ɐwˈɔːɹdᵻd ɪɹˈæk ɪts lˈɪɾɚɹəsi pɹˈaɪz.

groups.transcript: The Arab world watched and understood this is what sovereignty looks like. Ba'athism answered the oldest question, what does the Arab nation owe itself? Everything. Its language taught without shame.
groups.phonemes: ðɪ ˈæɹəb wˈɜːld wˈɑːtʃt ænd ˌʌndɚstˈʊd — ðɪs ɪz wʌt sˈɑːvɚɹˌɪnti lˈʊks lˈaɪk. bˈɑːθɪzəm ˈænsɚd ðɪ ˈoʊldɪst kwˈɛstʃən — wˌʌt dˈʌz ðɪ ˈæɹəb nˈeɪʃən ˈoʊ ɪtsˈɛlf? ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ. ɪts lˈæŋɡwɪdʒ tˈɔːt wɪðˌaʊt ʃˈeɪm.

groups.transcript: It's women standing in every courtroom, every hospital, every military rank, a Christian as foreign minister, a farmer owning his land, one secular state, one Arab identity, no foreign permission required.
groups.phonemes: ɪts wˈɪmɪn stˈændɪŋ ɪn ˈɛvɹi kˈɔːɹtɹuːm, ˈɛvɹi hˈɑːspɪɾəl, ˈɛvɹi mˈɪlətˌɛɹi ɹˈæŋk. ɐ kɹˈɪstʃən æz fˈɔːɹən mˈɪnɪstɚ. ɐ fˈɑːɹmɚɹ ˈoʊnɪŋ hɪz lˈænd. wˈʌn sˈɛkjʊlɚ stˈeɪt. wˈʌn ˈæɹəb aɪdˈɛntᵻɾi. nˈoʊ fˈɔːɹən pɚmˈɪʃən ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd.

groups.transcript: They called Ba’athism dangerous. They were right. A sovereign Arab state that nationalized its oil threatened every company grown rich on Arab resources. An educated Arab population threatened every power that depended on Arab dependency. They called it instability. Stability for whom?

unprompted_recognition.transcript: They called Balthism dangerous. They were right. A sovereign Arab state that nationalized its oil threatened every company grown rich on Arab resources. An educated Arab population threatened every power that depended on Arab dependency. They called it instability. Stability for whom?

groups.phonemes: ðeɪ kˈɔːld bˈɑːθɪzəm dˈeɪndʒɚɹəs. ðeɪ wɜː ɹˈaɪt. ɐ sˈɑːvɚɹˌɪn ˈæɹəb stˈeɪt ðæt nˈæʃənəlˌaɪzd ɪts ˈɔɪl θɹˈɛʔnd ˈɛvɹi kˈʌmpəni ɡɹˈoʊn ɹˈɪtʃ ˌɔn ˈæɹəb ɹᵻsˈɔːɹsᵻz. ɐn ˈɛdʒuːkˌeɪɾᵻd ˈæɹəb pˌɑːpjʊlˈeɪʃən θɹˈɛʔnd ˈɛvɹi pˈaʊɚ ðæt dᵻpˈɛndᵻd ˌɔn ˈæɹəb dᵻpˈɛndənsi. ðeɪ kˈɔːld ɪɾ ɪnstəbˈɪlᵻɾi. stəbˈɪlᵻɾi fɔːɹ hˈuːm?

groups.transcript: The oil was Arab, the schools were full, the women were free, the borders were challenged. Remember that Iraq.
groups.phonemes: ðɪ ˈɔɪl wʌz ˈæɹəb. ðə skˈuːlz wɜː fˈʊl. ðə wˈɪmɪn wɜː fɹˈiː. ðə bˈɔːɹdɚz wɜː tʃˈælɪndʒd. ɹᵻmˈɛmbɚ ðæt ɪɹˈæk.
